about.description: Software Engineer with 4 years building production backend systems, cloud infrastructure, and applied GenAI/RAG pipelines. Hands-on with an LLM-based RAG system alongside strong backend and DevOps-adjacent skills in Python, Golang, AWS, Docker, CI/CD, and observability. Currently at Skets Studio building a centralized Go API Gateway, event-driven AWS notification systems, and full observability stacks.
about.quote: Ship reliable backends, scale with confidence

timeline.summary: Centralized Go API Gateway + event-driven AWS platform with full observability and modern CI/CD.
bulletPoints: Built a centralized Go API Gateway serving 5 microservices with goroutine-based concurrency, channel-driven worker pools, context cancellation/timeouts, JWT auth, rate limiting, circuit breakers, routing, and service-to-service security.
Designed and shipped an event-driven notification system on AWS EventBridge and SQS (Golang consumers) with Dead Letter Queues and CloudWatch alerting, reducing undetected message failures by 20%.
Architected multi-stage GitLab CI/CD across QA, staging, and production with SonarQube gates, Trivy scanning, automated testing, and rollback, reducing deployment failures by 30%.
Adopted AWS Secrets Manager and OIDC-based deployments, eliminating hardcoded and long-lived cloud credentials.
Redesigned and normalized core database schemas with indexing, constraint optimization, and query tuning.
Architected isolated AWS dev environments with dedicated databases, cutting integration conflicts by 40%.
Built fault-tolerant video upload with S3 multipart uploads and IndexedDB fallback for interrupted recovery.
Engineered observability with Prometheus, Loki, OpenTelemetry, and Grafana (p95/p99, CPU/memory, error-rate), reducing incident resolution time by 25%.

timeline.summary: Scalable Python/Go/React applications and production microservices with monitoring and automation. Awarded Transformer of the Year (2024).
bulletPoints: Developed and maintained scalable web apps using Python (FastAPI), Golang (Gin), and React, supporting 200+ concurrent users.
Designed and maintained two production-grade microservices in Golang, improving scalability and modularity.
Implemented monitoring with AWS CloudWatch, SNS, and Grafana dashboards, cutting incident response time by 25%.
Automated end-to-end calling workflow integrating Dialpad via cron jobs and webhooks for real-time call tracking.
Conducted code reviews and debugging sessions, mentoring 4 junior developers.
Awarded Transformer of the Year (2024) for backend automation and DevOps optimization.

timeline.summary: Performance-critical product features, e-commerce platform, and legacy modernization.
bulletPoints: Enhanced two products with performance-critical features, reducing API response time by 20%.
Owned end-to-end design and development of the Seetech e-commerce platform (300+ concurrent users) with custom checkout and inventory flow.
Implemented secure auth with JWT and OAuth 2.0 plus role-based access control.
Migrated legacy PHP backend to Node.js, reducing API latency by 30% and modernizing 5+ core services.
Built an audio logger system using PostgreSQL and AWS S3, cutting issue-tracking turnaround by 30%.

projects.title: FinSight - Financial Filings RAG
projects.description: End-to-end financial RAG over SEC 10-K/10-Q using LangGraph, hybrid BM25 + pgvector retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and context compression with citation-grounded answers. Multi-LLM routing (OpenAI/Groq/Gemini) with failover and Pydantic-validated tools for live metrics. Verification + bounded retries, Redis checkpointing, HITL approval, and RAGAS + LLM-as-a-Judge eval over 30 questions.

projects.title: Fraud Detection System
projects.description: End-to-end credit-card fraud study on 284k ULB transactions (0.17% fraud). Compared logistic regression, shallow NN (73 params, best imbalanced F1 0.71), random forest, GBM and LinearSVC across imbalanced vs balanced regimes. RobustScaler + temporal splits, PR-focused evaluation, roadmap to LightGBM + calibration + FastAPI serving.

projects.title: TaskLattice - Multi-tenant Tasks Backend
projects.description: Multi-tenant task backend in Go: orgs → projects → tasks with RBAC (Owner/Admin/Member/Viewer), audit logs, transactional outbox + SQS workers + DLQ, Redis rate-limit/cache, idempotent writes, optimistic concurrency and cursor pagination. Gin + pgx + golang-migrate.

projects.title: ResearchMind - Multi-Agent Research
projects.description: 4-agent research pipeline (Search → Reader → Writer → Critic) on Groq llama-3.3-70b with Tavily search + BeautifulSoup scraping, structured Markdown reports and scored critiques. Streamlit UI with live progress + terminal mode via Rich.

projects.title: Alarum - CLI Alarm Clock
projects.description: Production-grade CLI alarm clock (Python, Typer + Rich). Natural time parsing, RRULE recurrence, wall-clock scheduler, foreground + daemon modes, atomic locked JSON state, audio → player → bell fallback, JSON scripting, doctor diagnostics, full pytest + CI matrix.
